about: The dataLayer contract this shop implements. It is the site's whole obligation: everything after the dataLayer (tags, GA4, ad platforms) is set up from it. Every push carries `event`, `event_id` and `contract_version`. Ecommerce events put their data under `ecommerce`, and the site pushes `{ ecommerce: null }` right before each one.

item.why: item_id must match the product feed, or ad platforms cannot tie a sale to a product. price and quantity must be numbers, because a string price is summed as text or dropped.

consent_update.when: The visitor answers the consent banner.

add_to_cart.when: A product is added to the cart.

add_payment_info.when: A payment method is chosen, just before leaving for the gateway.

purchase.when: The order is confirmed. Exactly once per transaction_id, even if the thank-you page is reloaded or reopened.

generate_lead.when: The contact form is sent. No personal data in the push or in the URL.
